headline: Paraguay Senate Impeaches President Santiago Peña Amid Ueno Bank Crisis
summary: Paraguay's Senate voted unanimously to impeach President Santiago Peña following the financial crisis and collapse of Ueno Bank. Following his removal and detention, Pedro Alliana is set to be sworn in as the new head of state.
why: Political instability and central bank intervention in systemic financial institutions directly affect sovereign risk, currency stability, and investor confidence in emerging market economies like Paraguay.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Impeachment of the sitting president creates immediate political and regulatory uncertainty for the nation's economy.
